title: Unstained Armor
subtitle: Purity through rejection
text: Unstained Armor represents the opposite path: anti-blood zealotry. Crafted from Consecrated Copper and Hemolytic Plating, it resists the infection's influence and provides protection against blood-based attacks. Wearing a full set marks you as an enemy of the Scarlet tradition. Expect hostility from Harbinger-aligned creatures.
